info.name: TruFinity Google Workspace Reporting (local)
info.description: Read-only reporting requests plus explicitly labelled work-item mutation requests. Set bearerToken to a freshly authorized client session. The local source currently exposes 13 Google routes; the requested 16-route inventory has three routes absent from google.routes.ts (see collection documentation). Do not run mutation requests during read-only verification.

item.name: Work item APIs (6 routes; mutations require explicit approval)
item.description: All routes require bearer authentication and client-only authorization. GET responses contain classification/work-item metadata and Gmail deep links. POST requests mutate work-item state and must not be run during a read-only test.

request.description: Query parameters: page, pageSize (max 100), mailbox_address, work_type, workflow_status, sla_state. 200 data: {items,total,page,pageSize}.
200 data is a metadata-only WorkItemRow; 404 for an unknown or non-UUID ID.
Mutation. 200 returns the updated WorkItemRow; 404 for unknown ID.
Mutation. Body requires resolution_note (1-2000 chars). 400 validation error, 200 updated item, or 404.
Mutation. Body dismissal_reason is optional, max 500 chars. 200 updated item, 404 for unknown/terminal item, or 400 validation error.

item.name: Responsiveness reporting APIs (7 implemented routes)
item.description: All routes are GET, bearer-authenticated, client-only, metadata-only. R01/R05 summary routes have no pagination; list routes use page/page_size capped at 100. R05 requires completed derived-state backfill and can return 503 R05_BACKFILL_INCOMPLETE before completion.

request.description: Filters: mailbox_address, status OPEN|REPLIED, classification EMERGENCY|GENERAL (or is_emergency=true|false), from_date, to_date. 200 data: totalCount, byStatus, byClassification.
Filters as summary plus page/page_size (max 100). 200 data: {page,pageSize,totalCount,data[]} with alert metadata and Gmail thread URL.
Filters: page, page_size (max 100), mailbox_address, status OPEN|RESOLVED, stall_reason INACTIVITY|EXCESSIVE_EXCHANGES. Returns stalled alert metadata.
Filters: page, page_size (max 100), mailbox_address, status ON_TIME|LATE, from_date, to_date. Returns reply-pair metadata and Gmail URL.
Filters: page, page_size (max 100), mailbox_address, status OPEN|RESOLVED. Returns after-hours backlog metadata.
Filter: mailbox_address. 200 data is per-mailbox aging metrics. Requires R05 backfill completion; otherwise 503 with code R05_BACKFILL_INCOMPLETE.
Filters: mailbox_address, page, page_size (max 100), sort oldest_first|newest_first. Returns paginated unanswered thread metadata and Gmail thread URLs.

item.name: Negative authorization examples (3 requests; do not use a real token)
item.description: These duplicate implemented routes to exercise 401/403 behavior. Leave Authorization empty or use a deliberately invalid placeholder. Never paste a production token into a saved collection.
